plan.coverage_notes: The plan covers core treatment modalities (CBT, IPT-A, behavioral activation, mindfulness, family therapy, pharmacotherapy, combination), modern delivery (digital), key clinical concerns (assessment, suicide risk, comorbidity), and implementation contexts (school-based, real-world). It includes recall-safety queries for RCTs and meta-analyses. Angles deliberately skipped per profile: neuroimaging, biomarkers, pure developmental neuroscience, and adult-focused research without adolescent application. The plan assumes the reader's primary need is for clinically actionable research on interventions and assessment.
